message.Title: Public Preview: Database Agent for SQL with contextual Copilot

Body.Content:
Database Agent now gives you AI-generated, evidence-grounded recommendations for detected database issues, including why the issue matters, the likely cause, and the recommended next step. 

Recommendations draw on available issue evidence and Microsoft-authored scenario knowledge. They distinguish observed evidence from AI-generated conclusions and communicate uncertainty when evidence is incomplete, stale, or conflicting. Recommendations are presented for your review before any state-changing action. 

Learn more.
